- **I11.0 – Hypertensive heart disease with heart failure.** ICD-10-CM presumes hypertension causes heart failure unless the provider says otherwise, so this combination code is listed first.
- **I50.33 – Acute on chronic diastolic (congestive) heart failure.** It is assigned with I11.0 to identify the type and acuity of the heart failure.

I did not add an external cause code or a long-term medication code such as Z79.899.

I could not check this against the FY2027 tables. Both codes are valid through FY2026, so confirm there were no changes to the I11 or I50 categories in the October 2026 release.

The documentation describes second-degree internal hemorrhoids: they prolapse with straining and retract spontaneously. That maps to K64.1. The bleeding is a routine sign of hemorrhoids, so it is not coded separately. No external cause applies. I assumed no FY2027 changes to the K64 category, so it is worth confirming that against the October 1, 2026 tabular.
